WellBeing Physiotherapy & Sports Injury Centre

16, Gopalnagar A, Near Triveni Flyover, Gopalpura Bypass Road, Jaipur.

Fully equipped with Latest Electrotherapy and Exercise machines and Advanced Manual Therapy Treatment Techniques

We are the leading physiotherapy service providers in Jaipur since last 12 years. WellBeing Physio Clinic located at centre of jaipur near Triveni flyover,  gopalpura mode with all facilities like parking, specious waiting area for attendant, canteen, and very peacefull physiotherapy and  rehabilitation department. 

We are specialized in spine, joints pain, paralysis, & obesity. We have successfully treated more than 50 thousand patients of Back pain, slipped disc, sciatica, knee pain, arthritis, hemiplegia, head or spinal injury, post surgical cases, sports injury cases, etc
